name: vb_storage
reason: Owns trim/snapshot keyspace encoding and decoding; sole implementation site for the bead.

name: constants.rs
reason: Declares JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES=17; candidate site for new MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN / MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN public aliases.

name: keys.rs
reason: Decoder already enforces length equality via KeyDecodeError::KeyLengthMismatch; encoder returns fixed-size [u8; JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES]. Likely no logic change, but new caps must reference the same constants and be re-exported if public.

name: trimming/mod.rs
reason: Defines TrimError::IncompleteTrim { deleted_count } typed variant (line 51) and diagnostic code 0x4102 (line 62). The typed-error surface the bead routes through.

name: trimming/logic.rs
reason: Primary fix surface. Three sites use magic 17 with kani/hazards: latest_durable_snapshot_seq:36, trim_events_for_run:77, count_trimmable_events:222. Replace literal with MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN/MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN while preserving fail-closed semantics.

name: trimming/helpers.rs
reason: Defines snapshot_prefix_key([u8; 9]); co-locate the new caps near this helper to keep 9-byte prefix and 17-byte full key adjacent in code.

name: trimming/tests.rs
reason: Tests trim_events_for_run_fails_closed_on_malformed_event_key (875-932) and trim_eligibility_diagnostic_fails_closed_on_malformed_event_key (934-987) pin the fail-closed semantics on short keys; must continue passing and be augmented with an explicit overlong-key case.

name: snapshots.rs
reason: put_snapshot (line 31) and snapshot (line 48) call run_snapshot_key which is fixed-size by return type. No change required, but ensure MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN constant stays consistent with the 17-byte encoder output.

name: snapshot_tests.rs
reason: latest_durable_snapshot_seq_rejects_malformed_overlong_key (208-248) is the Round 10 issue 7 regression — must continue to pass and be augmented with explicit overlong (length > 17) key cases.

name: keys/tests.rs
reason: Length-property tests for every prefix (workflow_source_key_length, run_header_key_length, run_event_key_length, etc.) already pin the canonical byte counts. Reference for verifying new caps stay aligned.

name: headers.rs
reason: Canonical typed-error precedent using JournalError::MalformedKeyspaceRow (lines 49-82). Should NOT be modified; reference pattern only.

name: preview.rs
reason: malformed_to_journal_error (lines 146-180) is the canonical KeyDecodeError -> MalformedKeyspaceRow translator. Reference pattern; no change expected.

name: error/mod.rs
reason: Hosts JournalError::MalformedKeyspaceRow variant (lines 98-105) and the Trim wrapper (line 187). If planner chooses to converge the trim path onto MalformedKeyspaceRow, a new typed-error mapping may be required here.

name: error/key_decode.rs
reason: KeyDecodeError enum (EmptyKey, UnknownPrefix, KeyLengthMismatch, InvalidRunId, ReservedSeqSentinel) is the parser-side typed error. Already complete for the cap requirement.

name: error/codes.rs
reason: Hosts MALFORMED_KEYSPACE_ROW_CODE (0x4030) and (optionally, for the trim path) relies on TrimError::INCOMPLETE_TRIM_CODE (0x4102). No new code expected unless planner adds a new variant.

name: error_code_tests.rs
reason: Has unit test (line ~244) verifying count_trimmable_events error code propagation. Must continue to pass with the new caps; no new test required unless code mapping changes.

name: latest_durable_snapshot_seq
reason: Triggers TrimError::IncompleteTrim on key.len()!=17 (line 36). Replace literal with MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN, keep Err semantics, preserve decode_storage_key re-check at line 43.

name: trim_events_for_run
reason: Loops events keyspace; rejects key.len()!=17 with TrimError::IncompleteTrim carrying partial deleted_count (line 77). Replace literal with MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN; preserve deleted_count accounting.

name: count_trimmable_events
reason: Diagnostic-time loop rejecting malformed key with JournalError::from(TrimError::IncompleteTrim) (line 222). Replace literal with MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN.

name: trim_eligibility_diagnostic
reason: Public-API caller of count_trimmable_events and latest_durable_snapshot_seq. No direct change expected; effect flows through the two callees.

name: trim_all_eligible_runs
reason: Batch wrapper that delegates per-run. No direct key-length handling on this function path; covered by its callees.

name: run_snapshot_key
reason: Encoder call routed by put_snapshot/snapshot. Fixed-size [u8; JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES] return guarantees canonical length; ensure new caps stay equal to JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES.

name: decode_storage_key
reason: Generic decoder already enforces bytes.len() == expected_len via KeyDecodeError::KeyLengthMismatch. Adequate for the bead; no change expected unless planner centralizes validation here.

name: run_headers
reason: Precedent for the typed MalformedKeyspaceRow error path. Reference only; not modified by the bead.

name: JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES
reason: Source-of-truth length=17 for RunEvent and RunSnapshot keys. New MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN and MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN aliases must be exactly equal to this value (compile-time).

name: PREFIX_RUN_SNAPSHOT
reason: Existing 0x12 prefix constant. Use this in any new typed error mapping so callers can disambiguate the keyspace prefix.

name: PREFIX_RUN_EVENT
reason: Existing 0x11 prefix constant. Use this in any new typed error mapping so callers can disambiguate the keyspace prefix.

name: latest_durable_snapshot_seq_rejects_malformed_overlong_key
reason: Round 10 issue 7 regression. Pins Err(TrimError::IncompleteTrim { deleted_count: 0 }) for a 13-byte key. Must continue to pass with the new caps; should be augmented with a 17<N-byte key case to exercise the literal cap.

name: trim_events_for_run_fails_closed_on_malformed_event_key
reason: vb-1rqz7.26 / SC-006. Plants a 9-byte key under the run-event prefix; asserts Err(TrimError::IncompleteTrim). Augment with explicit 17<N-byte key.

name: trim_eligibility_diagnostic_fails_closed_on_malformed_event_key
reason: vb-1rqz7.25 / CC-002. Validates JournalError::Trim -> TrimError::IncompleteTrim wrapping chain on the diagnostic path. Augment with explicit overlong-key case.

name: max-key-length-cap
reason: New clause: trim/snapshot keyspace scanners must reject any raw key whose length != MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN / MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN with a typed error carrying prefix + expected + actual. Planner must register clause ID with rust-contract.

name: default_rust_lane
reason: Unit tests for the cap constant + the failing-closed scanner branches. Bounds: arbitrary key bytes under PREFIX_RUN_SNAPSHOT and PREFIX_RUN_EVENT.

name: proptest
reason: proptest on the trim helpers (snapshot_prefix_key, sequencing). Generates arbitrary RunId/seq combos; verifies encoded keys always have length exactly MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN/MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN.

name: integration
reason: Existing integration tests under snapshot_tests.rs and trimming/tests.rs already plant malformed raw keys. Verifies the typed-error chain end-to-end through the Fjall backend.

name: kani
reason: Pure numeric/cap refinement against an already-bounded JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES=17. Kani bounded-model check adds no information once the cap constant equality is type-checked. Decision: do not write a Kani harness for this bead.

name: verus
reason: No new exec fn with a non-trivial bound. JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES is a const; verifying a const against itself is vacuous. Decision: do not write a Verus spec for this bead.

name: flux
reason: Pure length refinement on a usize value already discharged by const. Decision: do not write a Flux refinement for this bead.

name: fuzz
reason: Key encoders are pure 1-input=1-output ArrayVec writes; fuzzing adds no coverage beyond proptest roundtrip.

name: looom
reason: No concurrent state transition surface. Decision: do not write a Loom model for this bead.

name: vb_storage
reason: Internal-only bead; no Cargo.toml dependency changes expected.

name: moon
reason: No Moonfile / Moon cache-key change. `moon ci` remains the canonical gate; the unit/proptest/integration lanes above are exercised by the existing vb_storage test task.

name: temp_journal
reason: Existing helper used by both trimming/tests.rs and snapshot_tests.rs to spin up a tempdir-backed Fjall journal. Used to plant malformed under raw insert in tests 875-987 and 214-248. No change expected; just referenced for new tests.

name: alias-vs-replace
reason: Choose between (a) add public MAX_TRIM_KEY_LEN and MAX_SNAPSHOT_KEY_LEN aliases on top of JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES, (b) replace literal 17 with JOURNAL_KEY_BYTES in the three call sites, or (c) both. Bead wording leans toward (a) or (c).

name: typed-error-shape
reason: Reuse TrimError::IncompleteTrim { deleted_count } (already typed, code 0x4102) or converge on JournalError::MalformedKeyspaceRow (headers.rs precedent, code 0x4030)? Either is 'typed'; pick one and document the rationale.
